$comment: Explicit MarsScape -> mixmash/mars correspondence. The two codebases use different id conventions, so parity is decided by this mapping, never by a naive set diff. Every baseline feature is either resolvable to a target id (Ported) or carries a disposition below.

statuses.Ported: Rebuilt inside the server-authoritative engine and covered by a canonical test.
statuses.Intentionally Retired: Deliberately not carried forward. Requires an approved reason; the ledger will not accept this status without one.
statuses.Deferred: Will be ported in the named wave. Not yet started.

marsscape_v1 legacy save importer with quarantine + preview

saveFields.$comment: Old marsscape save (SAVE_KEY "marsscape_v1", SAVE_VERSION 4) -> canonical mixmash state. Unsupported values must be quarantined and reported, never silently discarded.
rules: Accept a marsscape_v1 export once, preview the conversion before committing it.
Create a server-owned session from the converted state; never trust client totals.
Preserve the original save verbatim for rollback.
Quarantine and report unmapped fields; do not drop them.

testContract.$comment: Behavioural test contract that must be represented in the canonical suite before cutover.
